_doc: Site display settings. Percentile thresholds decide when a stat's title (or its flip) is awarded on a player page.

player._doc: Player page layout. Overview tiles come first; their stats are left out of the category sections. In each category, up to featured_per_category stats at or above featured_min_pct (or deep in flip territory) get a big card; the rest are small cards, visible_small of them shown before a 'Show more' button.
